Dialogs.Dialog: What do you mean... Your girlfriend's going to study abroad, right？
Huh, man... how do you not know？
She got picked for the elite tennis program and she's going to America... for a year or two.
▲主人公＊▲. What's wrong, why the rush？
There's something I want to ask you, got a sec？
Um, sorry. I have something to do for Suzuki-sensei... I'm in a hurry, see you.
(Something for Suzuki-sensei... Don't tell me it's true？)
(I have to ask ▲高嶺＊＊▲ about studying abroad...)
(It's no use, she's not picking up...)
(Right. Something for Suzuki-sensei... the staff room？)
▲主人公＊▲. Were you waiting for me？
Yeah, there's something I really need to ask...
Sorry, after you waited for me. I have somewhere to stop by today, so I can't walk home with you.
(I need to get things straight about ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s studying abroad...)
Hello, sorry. What did you want to talk about？
I want to talk in person. Can I come over？
To my house？ I don't mind...
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Sorry for bugging you so much.
No, I'm the one who's been rushing around. Today's Papa's birthday.
Oh, really. Happy birthday... no, that's weird to say.
So I told Suzuki-sensei I'd skip practice today. On the way home, I bought cake ingredients.
Huh, so that's what it was. You weren't getting ready to study abroad...
？ Oh, right, Papa hates lies, but he was born on April Fool's Day. Funny, isn't it？
Huh... I see, today's April Fool's Day. ......What？
Sorry, a text... Ah, it's from that guy！
"Hey, you seem to be really worried about it, but you have already noticed the lie, haven't you？"
Don't laugh so much... I was seriously panicking.
Yes, thank you. For worrying that much. But there's no way I could leave you.
Hey, it's Golden Week, isn't it？
Um, I heard something from a friend in class.
If you share a long, lovely kiss with your sweetheart every day for three days of Golden Week, the 3rd to 5th...
(The one that goes on and on, I guess...)
Then the two of them will be happy, apparently.
From the sound of it, you didn't even notice we did it？
Hehe, it's fine. Because now we'll be happy.
(Now that she mentions it, I feel closer to ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
The Golden Week charm... didn't work, did it.
(Pool season starts today. It's a joint class, so ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
What？ Um... Does it look weird？
No, not weird！ ▲高嶺＊＊▲ looks good even in a school swimsuit.
Geez, flattering me won't get you anything. More importantly...
Don't look around so much. Looking at other girls is banned.
(I'm looking forward to pool class from now on！)
(Pool season starts today. It's a joint class, so ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
Oh, stop... But if you're only looking at me, it's okay.
Huh？ Oh, I see. Got it.
Well, I'm going. No wandering eyes, okay？
(I'm looking forward to pool class from now on！)
(Pool season starts today. It's a joint class, so ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
How is it？ Does a school swimsuit even suit anyone？
That's not true. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ has a great figure.
Huh？ I didn't mean it like that！
(I'm looking forward to pool class from now on！)
Hmm, against ▲高嶺＊＊▲, I'm not so confident.
Play... it's class time, you know？
It's fine, it's fine. This class is basically playtime anyway.
Is it？ Then, just a little.
All right, let's grab a ball first！
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Oh, you were behind me.
You were looking around. You want to see other girls' swimsuits that badly.
...Hehe, I know！ Were you looking for me？ Let's swim together！
I keep feeling eyes on me. Why, I wonder？
Maybe because I'm always with you even though we're in different classes. Should I go back？
...I think it's something else. If anything, you don't have to leave.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲... What's she doing in the corner？)
Yes, being in a swimsuit... it's embarrassing. So many girls have good figures...
I think ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s is pretty great too...
Um... nothing. Come on, let's go. Once you're in the water, nobody can see.
...Okay. If you're with me, I'll go.
Hey, when you see me in a swimsuit... does your heart race？
Oh... I wasn't really paying attention.
Hmm, nothing comes to mind right away.
Yes, if you write a wish on it, I'll hang it on the bamboo in our garden.
Really？ Then I'll think of something.
Hey, did you think of a wish？
Mine... if you show me yours, I'll show you mine.
I see... Then I'd better write mine first.
"May I always be happy together with ▲高嶺＊＊▲." ...Kind of obvious, though.
It's embarrassing having it read back... What about ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s？
Do I even need to show it？
Because it's the same. If we both make this wish, it's bound to come true, right？
(Done... Coming in just for this. Break school days are such a pain...)
(I'm sleepy from getting up early for once. Just a little...)
No, I just came to see you. Is that okay？
Yeah, of course. Seeing ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s face woke me right up.
Geez, you're such a smooth talker.
(Done... Coming in just for this. Break school days are such a pain...)
Yes. My class got out early.
Not really... I just wanted to talk. Is that not enough？
No way. Sure, want to go somewhere else？
(Done... Coming in just for this. Break school days are such a pain...)
Not really, I'm just happy to see you at school.
We can see each other even when it's not a school day. Like at club.
Geez, don't say such cold things. Let's talk？ Come on！
(Hmm. Break school days are a pain.)
"What a pain." ...That's what your face says？
At this rate, the new term's going to be rough？ Straighten up.
(Hmm. Break school days are a pain.)
Ah, no. I'm just sleepy, don't worry.
I'm fine. Seeing ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s face perked me up, right？
(Hmm. Break school days are a pain.)
You look down. At least on school days, let's be energetic？
It's finally the day, huh？ I hope your practice pays off.
Yeah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ cheered me on, after all. I'll do my best to deliver.
Yes, fight！ I'll do my best too.
The girl who was supposed to run the next three-legged race with me got hurt...
It's sudden, but would you run it with me？
Me？ But I might hold ▲高嶺＊＊▲ back...
No. I've seen how hard you've been practicing. So I believe in you.
▲高嶺＊＊▲... Okay, let's do it together.
We did it, we won together！
Yeah, even with no practice. I guess we really are a good match.
Hehe, right. And you looked so cool running.
I can't tell myself. What's really amazing is ▲高嶺＊＊▲. You even got MVP.
Even that was because we won the three-legged race.
Thanks to how hard you tried.
It's not that big a deal...
Oh, right. I'm not that into it, so I forgot.
What about the Takane house？ You guys love events.
Not even we go as far as Halloween...
Right. It'd be fun to do something, though.
(Nothing good on TV. What to do...)
Sorry to intrude. Can I come in？
What's up, all of a sudden？
So that's what you wanted to do, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Yes, I wanted to surprise you.
I was surprised, all right, in lots of ways. I never thought ▲高嶺＊＊▲ would do something so bold...
(I worked hard on the organizing committee. I hope it goes well...)
Yes. My class is doing a maid cafe. Um...
Huh, is it... weird after all？
It's not weird！ It's not that...
No, you made a weird face... It's time to switch shifts anyway, so I'll go change.
(Glad the culture festival ended without a hitch. Just the party left.)
Good work on the committee. You worked so hard.
Yeah. I'm relieved it went fine.
Hey. Sorry to bother you when you're tired, but do you have time after this？
Until they start tearing down the venue... What's up？
Mm. Come with me for a bit.
Ahh, it's quiet here. But why the tennis courts？
Because it's a place full of memories. You haven't forgotten, right？
Of course not. It all started here for us.
Yes. It started here, and we made lots of memories, like today...
Happiness like this will keep going, right？
Morning. Summer classes start today, let's go for it？
Geez, don't slack off right away. Hehe.
Good morning. Summer classes start today, so let's work hard without overdoing it？
Work hard without overdoing it... That's tough.
Hehe. I'll work hard with you.
Morning！ Let's do our best in summer classes starting today？
Morning. Getting used to summer classes？
So-so？ Then I'll be so-so too... Just kidding.
Good morning. Are summer classes hard？
Really？ If it gets tough, let's study together.
Morning！ Thanks to summer classes, we get to walk to school together.
That's one part. Let's study while we're at it？ Just kidding.
Morning. Winter classes start today. Let's not lose to the cold？
Trying hard is fine, but I think I'll lose to the cold...
Hehe. Then let's walk close together？
Good morning. Winter classes start today. Take care of yourself, okay？
Yes, thank you. Let's do our best together.
Yeah, that's right！ ...Nope, that used up all my energy.
Geez, I'll share some of mine. Let's go！
Morning. With winter classes, keeping at it is what counts, right？
Right, right, keeping at it. Yep. Brr...
Geez, you're not listening. But it really is cold.
Good morning. You haven't caught a cold？
I'm fine. I won't lose to winter classes.
Morning！ It's cold every day, huh.
If it weren't for winter classes, I could stay home.
Nope. I'd drag you out anyway！ Hehe.
Morning. Spring classes start today. They're short, so let's focus？
Right. So at least do the classes properly.
Good morning. Spring classes, let's do our best starting today？
Yes. So don't let your guard down.
Morning！ I hope spring classes are fun？
It's studying, you know？ ...Is that fun？
It pays to enjoy it. So, okay？
Morning. How are spring classes going？
That's not what I meant... Hehe, you really do look sleepy.
Good morning. Spring classes... make me a little sleepy.
Even ▲高嶺＊＊▲ gets sleepy, huh. Then I'm even sleepier.
Geez... How does that follow？ Hehe.
Morning！ How are spring classes？ Going well？
By the way, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Did you hear about the contest？
A swimsuit contest. They're holding one.
Anyway, wouldn't ▲高嶺＊＊▲ win if she entered？
The swimsuit contest. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ won, they said.
Well... ▲高嶺＊＊▲ has a great figure. Of course she won！
As your boyfriend, I'm proud too！
Is that so？ Then I guess... it's good？
